description: This file defines data models and utility functions for representing endpoint examples, including API and Python code examples, using Pydantic models with validation and mock data generation.

classes.name: Example
classes.description: Base model for endpoint examples with an abstract method to generate Python code.

classes.name: APIEx
classes.description: API example model extending Example, with additional fields, validation, and mock data generation.

classes.name: PythonEx
classes.description: Python code example model extending Example, with method to generate Python code.

methods.name: to_python
methods.description: Generates a Python code string representation of the example.

methods.name: mock_data
methods.description: Generates mock data for time series or panel datasets.

methods.name: filter_list
methods.description: Filters a list of examples based on provider and scope.
